#load data
```{r}
#load data
asv=read.table("~/median/median_euc.csv", sep=",", row.names=1, header=TRUE, check.names=FALSE)
taxa=read.table("~/median/median_taxa_euc.csv", sep=",", row.names=1, header=TRUE)
meta=read.table('~/median/median_meta_euc.csv', sep=",", row.names=1, header=TRUE)
```


# Modify metadata file to add colum for bioreactor, time, replicate # 
```{r}
meta$sample_name=row.names(meta)
meta=separate(data = meta, col = sample_name, into = c("experience", "short_sample_type", "time", "bioreactor", "replicate"), sep = "-")

meta$Sample_type=factor(meta$Sample_type,levels = c("Rock", "Peatbog", "Groundwater")) 

meta$position_pastille = as.character (meta$position_pastille)

meta$sample_name=row.names(meta)

meta$time<-gsub("T","",as.character(meta$time))
meta$time = as.integer (meta$time)
meta$position_pastille[meta$Sample_type == "Groundwater"] <- NA
```

#remove unwanted samples from analysis (Peatbog and B0)
```{r, eval=FALSE}
meta=subset(meta, !Sample_type=='Peatbog')
#meta=subset(meta, !bioreactor=='B0')
meta$Sample_type <- droplevels(meta$Sample_type)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#split meta into meta_1 and meta_2
meta_1 <- subset(meta, experience == 'E1' & (short_sample_type == 'R' | bioreactor == 'B0'))
meta_2 <- subset(meta, experience == 'E2'  & (short_sample_type == 'W' | bioreactor == 'B0'))
```


#Observed through time
```{r}

#create phyloseq object
ps=phyloseq(otu_table(asv, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), tax_table(as.matrix(taxa)), sample_data(meta_1))

richness_df_1 = cbind(estimate_richness(ps,measures = 'Observed'),
            sample_data(ps))

#check for normality
hist(richness_df_1$Observed, breaks = 71) #good for both except one outlier for euc

# plot richness through time
ggplot(richness_df_1, aes(x = time, y = Observed)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(y = Observed, color = bioreactor, group = bioreactor), size = 1, linetype = "solid") + 
#  ylim(0, 75) + #to visualize without the outlier
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Richness through time",
       x = "time",
       y = "Richness (Observed)")
```
evenness through time
```{r}

#create phyloseq object
ps=phyloseq(otu_table(asv, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), tax_table(as.matrix(taxa)), sample_data(meta_1))


even_df_1 = cbind(estimate_richness(ps,measures =c('Shannon', 'Observed')),
            sample_data(ps))

#get Evenness
even_df_1$Evenness <- even_df_1$Shannon / log(even_df_1$Observed)

#check normality
hist(even_df_1$Evenness) #has a heavy right tail for euc, better for euc, but still there

# Evenness through time
ggplot(even_df_1, aes(x = time, y = Evenness)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(y = Evenness, color = bioreactor, group = bioreactor), size = 1, linetype = "solid") + 

  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Evenness through time",
       x = "time",
       y = "Evenness  (Pielou's Index)")
```
#Shannon through time
```{r}

#create phyloseq object
ps=phyloseq(otu_table(asv, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), tax_table(as.matrix(taxa)), sample_data(meta_1))

shannon_df_1 = cbind(estimate_richness(ps,measures = 'Shannon'),
            sample_data(ps))

#check normality
hist(shannon_df_1$Shannon) #good enough for both

# Ajouter la colonne "time" depuis les métadonnées à la table de richesse
shannon_df_1$time <- sample_data(ps)$time

# Tracer la richesse à travers le time
ggplot(shannon_df_1, aes(x = time, y = Shannon)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(y = Shannon, color = bioreactor, group = bioreactor), size = 1, linetype = "solid") + 

  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Shannon Through time",
       x = "time",
       y = "Alpha diversity (H)")
```

#exp. 2
#Observedthrough time
```{r}

#create phyloseq object
ps=phyloseq(otu_table(asv, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), tax_table(as.matrix(taxa)), sample_data(meta_2))

richness_df_2 = cbind(estimate_richness(ps,measures = 'Observed'),
            sample_data(ps))

#check richness
hist(richness_df_2$Observed) #good for euc, good enough for euc

# plot richness through time
ggplot(richness_df_2, aes(x = time - 21, y = Observed)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(y = Observed, color = bioreactor, group = bioreactor), size = 1, linetype = "solid") + 
#  ylim(0, 300) + #to visualize without the outlier
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Richness through time",
       x = "time",
       y = "Richness (Observed)")
```
evenness through time
```{r}

#create phyloseq object
ps=phyloseq(otu_table(asv, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), tax_table(as.matrix(taxa)), sample_data(meta_2))

even_df_2 = cbind(estimate_richness(ps,measures =c('Shannon', 'Observed')),
            sample_data(ps))

#get Evenness
even_df_2$Evenness <- even_df_2$Shannon / log(even_df_2$Observed)

#check normality
hist(even_df_2$Evenness) #the normality of evenness for E1 and E2 are rather wonky, but not in the same way for euc, wonky for euc aswell

# Richness through time
ggplot(even_df_2, aes(x = time - 21, y = Evenness)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(y = Evenness, color = bioreactor, group = bioreactor), size = 1, linetype = "solid") + 

  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Evenness through time",
       x = "time",
       y = "Evenness (Pielou's Index)")
```
#Shannon through time
```{r}

#create phyloseq object
ps=phyloseq(otu_table(asv, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), tax_table(as.matrix(taxa)), sample_data(meta_2))

shannon_df_2 = cbind(estimate_richness(ps,measures = 'Shannon'),
            sample_data(ps))

hist(shannon_df_2$Shannon) #not normal for euc, good enough for euc

# Ajouter la colonne "time" depuis les métadonnées à la table de richesse
shannon_df_2$time <- sample_data(ps)$time

# Tracer shannon à travers le time
ggplot(shannon_df_2, aes(x = time - 21, y = Shannon)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(y = Shannon, color = bioreactor, group = bioreactor), size = 1, linetype = "solid") + 

  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Shannon Through time",
       x = "time",
       y = "Alpha diversity (H)")
```

```{r}
wilcox.test(richness_df_1$Observed, richness_df_2$Observed)

wilcox.test(even_df_1$Evenness, even_df_2$Evenness)
```
